profile.overview: Prismari is Strixhaven's blue-red College of Elemental Arts.
profile.philosophy: Magic and art are the same act when craft, emotion, elemental force, and chosen medium become expression.
profile.core_tension: Prismari balances disciplined refinement with raw expression; the strongest cases integrate technique, feeling, revision, and responsibility.
profile.social_or_institutional_role: The official guides frame Prismari as the College of Elemental Arts, where students practice, collaborate, apprentice, submit work, and use elemental media as art.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Prismari's mechanical and thematic identity centers on spells, elemental scale, performance, and expressive payoff.
profile.placement_use: Use this profile to support thematic placement, quiz design, and lore browsing. Do not present placement inferences as canon.

limitations: This is a compact first-pass JSON package generated from official overview and mechanics sources.
Novel-level or story-episode-specific details should be added in a later deep-dive pass with direct story citations.

core_identity.summary: Prismari is Strixhaven's blue-red College of Elemental Arts, where magic becomes art through trained technique, expressive purpose, and elemental media.
core_identity.philosophy: Prismari treats magic and art as the same act. Its central question is how practiced craft and expressive emotion can intensify one another rather than collapse into technique-only or spectacle-only work.
core_identity.central_tension: Prismari balances disciplined refinement with raw expression, including the responsibility to revise, collaborate, and contain the consequences of powerful creative work.

site_surface.tagline: Magic and art are the same act when craft, emotion, elemental force, and chosen medium become expression.

structure.summary: The official guides frame Prismari as the College of Elemental Arts, whose students study artistic disciplines, practice technique, collaborate, apprentice, and make magic through elemental media.

great_tension.summary: Technique and expression are an internal tension that can be integrated: craft can carry feeling, and feeling needs form and responsibility to remain art rather than unmanaged force.
great_tension.placement_relevance: Distinguishes mature integration from technique-only optimization, generic spectacle, and consequence-free intensity.
